performance_case.causal_mechanism: A sealed pre-outcome semantic boundary can prevent post-outcome factor invention by proving whether one later single-factor question is expressible before any report value or BTC return is visible.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only that the already accepted CFTC CME Bitcoin TFF source design and disabled V2 contract contain enough identity, category, representation, timing, eligibility and missingness semantics for Manager to freeze one later single-factor preregistration task without outcome access. It does not select a field, category, formula, transform, sign, threshold, horizon or strategy mapping; prove source continuity, operational capture, predictive value, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement or candidate readiness; authorize OOS, deployment or Trading; or count as an independent weekly output.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future factor may reduce path risk only after a separately preregistered definition passes prospective predictive, matched-capital economic and drawdown-path gates; that remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One bounded semantic review costs no data collection or performance run and prevents premature formula selection. A positive result allows one later preregistration task; a wait or integrity result stops spend at the exact missing proof while R1 and R2 continue independently.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL effect is zero. The only present value is reducing research-selection latency and overfitting risk by forcing factor expressibility to be judged before values and outcomes are available.
